1#main: The law of kilayim and tzitzit for the dead. In it are 2 seifim. Shrouds of the dead — it is permitted to make them from kilayim.
2#main: One does not bury the dead except in a tallit that has tzitzit: {Rama: And some say tzitzit is not required (Tur in the name of some authorities); and the custom is to bury him in tzitzit, but that they invalidate the tzitzit first, or they tie one of the corners.}
